changes.summary: John Knight creates projects in situ, which are the result of careful observation of specific sites, and ex situ, which bring references to other places into the exhibition space. Whether in situ or ex situ, Knight’s works are context dependent, crystalizing the social, political, and economic forces that structure our built environment. John Knight: A work in situ is curated by Giampaolo Bianconi, associate curator, Modern and Contemporary Art.
